profile_text.body:
Uber Technologies, Inc. describes its platform as a way for users to earn more, eat, commute, get a ride, and simplify business travel. The company's website states that it is introducing autonomous vehicles as a key part of the future, partnering with industry leaders and using a safety-driven approach to combine autonomous vehicles and drivers.

The company's site highlights autonomous vehicles as a central part of its future plans, but does not name specific AI products in the available material. Its description of autonomous vehicle efforts includes partnerships with industry leaders and a safety-driven approach.

Uber Technologies, Inc. is a public company headquartered in San Francisco, CA, and trades under the ticker UBER. Its SEC Central Index Key is 0001543151. Public records show 281 legal exposure entries in California. The company also appears under the alias UBER TECHNOLOGIES INC.
